SELECT FALSE AS bool_assist, task.id AS task_id, (task.task_quantity - IFNULL(t1.reported_quantity, 0)) AS unreported_quantity, product.id AS 'product.id', product.serial_number AS 'product.serial_number', product.name AS 'product.name', product.specification AS 'product.specification', product.monomer_id AS 'product.monomerId', p.id 'project.id', p.`name` 'project.name', p.short_name 'project.short_name', p.serial_number 'project.serial_number', m.id 'monomer.id', m.`name` 'monomer.name', a.id 'area.id', a.`name` 'area.name' FROM mes_building_task task LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbptr.task_id, SUM(mbptr.inspection_quantity) AS reported_quantity FROM mes_building_produce_team_report mbptr WHERE mbptr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbptr.process_id = #{processId} and mbptr.team_id = #{teamId} GROUP BY mbptr.task_id ) t1 ON t1.task_id = task.id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON task.product_id = product.id LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification class ON product.structure_class_id = class.id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON task.product_id = product.id LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config class ON product.assemble_config_id = class.id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON task.product_id = product.id LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification class ON product.steel_id = class.id
LEFT JOIN contract_project p ON p.id = task.project_id AND p.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer m ON m.id = task.monomer_id AND m.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area a ON a.id = task.area_id AND a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE WHERE task.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND task.task_quantity > IFNULL(t1.reported_quantity, 0) AND task.task_type_enum & #{productType} AND task.workshop_id = #{workshopId} and task.project_id = #{projectId} and task.monomer_id = #{monomerId} and task.area_id = #{areaId}
and class.id = #{productClassId}
and product.serial_number LIKE concat('%', #{productSerialNumber}, '%')
